title: Arithmetic Unitarity II: The Light Cone of the Weil Form
summary: Volume I (ai.viXra:2610.0045v2) showed that the Riemann Hypothesis (RH) is equivalent to unitarity, meaning the absence of negative-norm ("ghost") directions, of the logarithmic scaling flow for the Weil form Q. This volume measures that obstruction directly in one geometric language: the Weil form is the transverse part of a Lorentzian form. For curves over F_q, the Hodge index theorem makes NS(C x C) Lorentzian, the graph of Frobenius is the diagonal boosted by rapidity (1/2) log q, and Weil's bound is Cauchy-Schwarz on the transverse part.
